item.title: Book Review | Great Nicobar: A Perfect Storm in the Making
item.description: Great Nicobar is near maritime routes like the Strait of Malacca, making it attractive for port and logistic infrastructure. Island on Edge forces readers to ask: At what cost?

item.description: The book starts with Baba reminiscing about his early days, how he ran away from home to learn music, in Kolkata, his training under the greatest musician at the time, Ustad Wazir Khan of Rampur

item.title: Book Review | The Charisma of Narayana Guru
item.description: It was a fact that Narayana Guru was from Ezhava community, which was low in the hierarchical system dominated by the ruthless Brahmin orthodoxy of the time

item.title: Bhopinder Singh | Take Action Fast To Deter Nepal From Going The Bangladesh Way
item.description: Proud Nepalis would rightfully insist on their historic independence and not having been occupied/colonised by any foreign power, ever

item.title: Manish Tewari | The Reasons Why India Needs An Open Budget
item.description: The historical origins of this secrecy are deeply rooted in the exigencies of colonial control and, even further back, in the political machinations of 18th-century Britain

item.title: Shreya Sen-Handley | Tricks To Make Those New Year Vows Stick
item.description: How deep into January did your nuts-only-lunch/barefoot-hikes/grinning-till-your-cheeks-smart last? It’s merely human to be epic-fails and tryhards, giving up on rock-climbing/fastidious-flossing/olive-branching, before a fortnight has passed

item.title: Bharat Bhushan | Governors As Agents Of Delhi? Let’s Scrap Post
item.description: While previous governments at the Centre have also misused governors, the problem has become much more acute under the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). What was episodic and less visible has become in-your-face

item.title: AA Edit | Inroads Into TN, Kerala May Be Hard For NDA
item.description: It is understandable that Mr Modi attacked the DMK on many of its fault lines like domination of party by one family, the issue of corruption that is a longstanding one in the nearly 60-year history of a Dravidian duopoly in Tamil Nadu and the tendency lately of drugs being freely available in the state drawing students and the youth into its seductive embrace
